theme: A quiet last day on the water before the long trip home.
greeting: Buon giorno, Dan — the sailing course wraps at noon tomorrow, so today is largely yours on the Adriatic. The one thing worth doing before you lose signal is locking down the shore logistics.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat shore logistics
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends at noon tomorrow at Komolac. The Cavtat transfer, an early bag hold before 3 PM check-in, and Sunday's ~5:15 AM express checkout all need arranging from dry land before you're offline.

needsAttention.title: Last call on the St Pete Airbnb
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete booking is set to charge today, after which it's locked. If a better option exists, this is the last day to switch.

needsAttention.title: Two St Pete nights still open
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday afternoon, but the Sept 20–21 nights before the Orlando villa aren't booked — close the gap before you're jet-lagged at a walk-up counter.
